landing.authDescription: To access your financial workspace, create an account or sign in.
landing.tagline: Budget with precision. Track every expense. Make decisions with real data — not guesses.
landing.featBudgetsDesc: Create multiple budgets for different periods and financial goals.
landing.featCategoriesDesc: Split expenses into custom sections and categories with full control.
landing.featTrendsDesc: Visualize how your spending evolves month by month with clear charts.
landing.featSecureDesc: Your data protected with robust authentication and encryption.
landing.featMultiCurrencyDesc: Manage budgets in any world currency without restrictions.
landing.featRealTimeDesc: Data updated instantly. Always synced, never outdated.
landing.chartsDescription: Real-time charts showing spending trends and the exact breakdown of every category.
landing.step1Desc: Set your income and billing period. Choose guided 50/30/20 or full manual setup.
landing.step2Desc: Organize into sections like Needs, Wants, and Savings, with specific categories inside each.
landing.step3Desc: Add each expense in seconds. Assign it to the right category for precise tracking.
landing.step4Desc: See trends, category breakdowns, and budget usage metrics in real time.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Manage your finances properly. Give yourself the chance to organize your economy.
